name: 久坐不塌陷儿童增高坐垫款
description: 高密海绵厚软回弹、三档厚度适配身高、防滑固定与安全细节、多场景安心使用

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating rounded-corner warm sand and soft mint panels, thin wood-grain divider bands, hanging scroll paper frames
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft warm studio light, gentle top-front key, soft contact shadows, no harsh specular
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte fabric-textured panels with soft woven cushion surfaces

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm baby-friendly ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm sand background #D9B48C, soft beige card panel #F2E8D5, soft mint green panel #A9D3C2, deep charcoal text #3F3F3F, and marigold yellow accent #E9C63F; warm-toned bright soft studio lighting with a gentle top-front key and soft contact shadows; rounded friendly sans-serif headlines wrapped in 「」 in deep charcoal #3F3F3F; alternating rounded-corner sand and mint content panels separated by thin wood-grain divider bands; glossy sphere medallion badges, ribbon pill banners, dashed-border tags and numbered coral circles #E86A5E as the only infographic devices; product centered and stable with rounded-corner cushion geometry; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索场景下清晰剪影先赢点击，主图无文字符合平台规范。

shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Centered front 3/4 view at eye level, full cushion visible and upright, filling 60-70% of the frame with even clean margins around it on the white field. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill card, soft contact shadow grounding the cushion. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. Ultra-sharp commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no child, no text, no watermark, no fake logo, no decorative elements, no colored background, no cut-off edges, no floating product.

provenance.notes: 源为一张母婴类详情页长图，按 800x1200、60px 重叠切成 16 片逐片分析后拼合还原版面；sourceImageCount 记录分析片数。源文件夹标注为母婴、文件名为宝宝增高坐垫，识图确认为儿童增高坐垫（餐椅/学习椅增高垫，主打吃饭与学习场景），与文件名一致；归类按 taxonomy 取 L1=母婴、L2=出行（儿童座椅/安全座椅配件族，属 taxonomy 母婴下精确 L2 串），而非按用途归喂养或寝居。已剥离：素材站水印、店铺会员二维码、具体图案名（小恐龙-A 等改写为通用花色标签）、儿童模特面部（改为背影/裁切/虚化）、源图文案（质保十年、退全款、CMA/甲醛检测、4000次/5级/95% 等声明一律不写入，规格值由生成时供给，不虚构认证与检测数据）。信任与收口镜不设任何徽章或证照占位，以缝线包边等可验证视觉细节与售后承诺横幅承载可信感。
